output_text: Robert McNaughton, 51, from Halesowen, set up fake Facebook accounts to troll his ex-partner, West Midlands Police said. He was convicted of conspiracy to commit criminal damage and became "hell bent" on destroying her life after she spurned his reconciliation attempts. During December 2014 and February 2015, he bombarded her with abusive Facebook messages, threatened to release intimate images, and hired two men to carry out a string of attacks on her home, culminating with her car being set on fire in February 2015. Matthew Barker, 44, of Leicester, and Joden Smith, 20, of Leicester, admitted conspiracy to commit criminal damage and arson, recklessly endangering life, and were sentenced at Wolverhampton Crown Court on 31 March.
